info.title: Neta-Resume API
info.description: Read-only resume aggregate for Indian legislators. Every fact carries provenance.

get.description:
Browse legislators (directory): filter by house/state/constituency/jurisdiction/party/cases/theme/
search, sort by assets|cases|attendance|theme_questions|name, and page via limit/offset. `cycle` (a Lok
Sabha cycle number) browses that session's roster as it stood at the time. Total match count is returned
in the `X-Total-Count` response header (the body stays a plain list).
Dropdown option lists (party / state / house / LS session, each with a count) for a browse scope.
National dashboard: totals + theme mix + top ministries + most-active MPs, for the given house.
The full ranked list of ministries by question count, for the given house.

schema.title: Response Parliament Ministries Parliament Ministries Get

get.description:
Topic search over question subjects + debate titles for the given house. Filter by kind/theme, page via
limit/offset; the total match count is in the `X-Total-Count` header (body stays a plain list).

schema.title: Response Parliament Search Parliament Search Get

get.description: Monthly question volume split by policy theme, for the given house — the stacked-area trends view.
Theme-emphasis mix per party or state, for the given house: each group's policy-theme shares + volume.
Fuzzy search legislators by name (uses person.normalized_name trigram index).
Real counts (total / per house / with cases / crorepatis) — not capped by any list limit.

post.description: Atomically increment the unique-visitor count and return the new total.

get.description: All registered elections. Past entries carry a winner_count + house (results reuse /persons?house=…).
The full India Dashboard: every catalogued macro series (history + latest), grouped by category.

Entries matching the filter (date ascending, then id), plus topic/people facets and checked/unchecked
counts scoped to that same filtered set.
Every person on record, with role/tenure from their profile entry and a linked-entry count.

schema.title: Response People Eci Files People Get

get.description: One person's profile (if linked) plus their full timeline.

AggregateGroup.title: AggregateGroup
AggregateGroup.description: One party or state's collective question profile (18th Lok Sabha).

EciResponseRef.title: EciResponseRef
EciResponseRef.description: One entry that answers another (`response_to` points back at the charge it responds to).

EciTimeline.title: EciTimeline
EciTimeline.description: The filtered ECI Files timeline — entries plus facets scoped to the same filter.

Facets.title: Facets
Facets.description: Dropdown option lists for a browse scope (party / state / house / theme), each with its row count.

FirstOffice.title: FirstOffice
FirstOffice.description:
The earliest public office on record — a person's 'entered public life' anchor.

Derived (not stored): the earliest-dated of the person's office_terms and leadership roles. It's only
as deep as the sourced record reaches, so it's a floor ('at least since'), never a claim of the very
first office ever held. Carries the provenance of whichever fact it was derived from.

IndiaDashboard.title: IndiaDashboard
IndiaDashboard.description:
The India Dashboard aggregate — country-level macro indicators, grouped by category.

Descriptive official statistics (World Bank Open Data, CC-BY 4.0, trust tier 1) — what the record
says, never a judgment. Every series carries its own source link and its latest year (series lag
differs: GDP is near-current, survey series like the Gini update only in survey years).

IndicatorSeries.title: IndicatorSeries
IndicatorSeries.description: One macro series (e.g. GDP) — full yearly history + the latest value, with provenance.

ParliamentStats.title: ParliamentStats
ParliamentStats.description: Institutional-lens dashboard: what the House is asking (currently the 18th Lok Sabha).

ParliamentaryActivity.title: ParliamentaryActivity
ParliamentaryActivity.description: What an MP did in the House — counts with peer context, from PRS MP Track (CC-BY 4.0).

ParliamentaryRecord.title: ParliamentaryRecord
ParliamentaryRecord.description:
Individual questions asked + debates joined — the content behind the activity counts.

Enumerated from PRS MP Track profiles (CC-BY 4.0). `*_count` is the full total; the lists are capped
(most-recent first) to bound payload — the UI shows "showing N of total".

RecordHit.title: RecordHit
RecordHit.description: One topic-search hit — a question or debate matching the query (18th Lok Sabha).

ThemeFocus.title: ThemeFocus
ThemeFocus.description:
One policy theme's weight in an MP's questions, vs the House — the 'Policy focus' breakdown.

Descriptive topical emphasis derived from the official ministry each question addressed (never a value
judgment). `share` = this MP's fraction of questions in the theme; `house_share` = the same fraction
pooled across all sitting members of the house (None until the house corpus is large enough to average).

ThemeFocusBreakdown.title: ThemeFocusBreakdown
ThemeFocusBreakdown.description:
Descriptive theme-emphasis breakdown by party or state — what a group's members collectively raise.

Topical emphasis derived from the official ministry each question addressed; a comparison of focus, never
a value judgment or productivity ranking (same ethic as the per-MP 'Policy focus'). Missing ≠ zero.

Trends.title: Trends
Trends.description: Monthly question volume split by policy theme (stacked-area trends over the term).
